theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)), μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ → ∀ (xs : ℕ → Euclid P) (lams : ℕ → ℝ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (K : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ i, 0 < lams i ∧ lams i ≤ 1 ∧ ‖xs i‖ ≤ 1 - lams i) → (∀ K' : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K' → ν K' ≠ ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun i => ∫ x, f x ∂(ENNReal.ofReal ((lams i)⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation (xs i) (lams i)))) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂ν))) → IsCompact K → (∀ i, ¬ K ⊆ dilation (xs i) (lams i) '' ball 0 2) → ∃ (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), (0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧ ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - lam) ∧ ν = (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) ∧ ¬ K ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2
